description: Apple Safari on macOS via a use.computer remote sandbox. Safari is preinstalled on macOS so install_safari.sh only verifies the bundle and enables the Develop menu. setup_safari.sh writes baseline preferences via `defaults` to suppress first-run prompts and provide a known privacy baseline. Tasks cover bookmarks, downloads, site permissions, Web Inspector / DevTools workflows, and privacy hardening — all stored in user-readable plist / JSON / SQLite files under ~/Library/Safari/ and ~/Library/Preferences/.
